summary: Check scenario modes for every CSF loaded by kit Storybook, including app stories

replay.detail: No deployed replay or runtime data change.

compatibility.detail: Storybook and scenario checks share one CSF inventory. Ten existing undeclared app stories are pinned in a separate shrink-only deferral owned by fractal-web-app; new stories must declare modes and declared or removed entries must leave the list. Exempt and deferred app CSFs receive the forbidden-domain runtime import-graph check; declared slice CSFs consume the kit normally. Vite raw and URL queries resolve existing base files as leaves without bypassing forbidden fixture paths. Inline flags are leaves only for recognized non-code assets and fail closed for executable modules. Existing blocked-PR debt and exemption pins are unchanged. This development-only change does not alter deployed protocols.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
